_meta.source: Official Archero 2 hotfix patch notes, pasted by Kyle (guild owner) on 2026-08-28 from official Archero 2 channels. The source gives NO version number, so none is recorded anywhere in this fragment. Umbral Tempest Season 4 begins 31 August 2026.
_meta.confidence: high for everything the notes state verbatim. These notes SUPERSEDE the in-game Update Preview of 2026-08-23 already folded in as update-2026-08-23.json: that preview used several different English names for the same features, and this fragment repairs each one. Verified by scripts/answer-check.js against the real model. Guards added for the name collisions this drop introduces (Sword Will/Sword Strike, Alchemist class/Talent Card, Main Weapon Restriction Shield/Main Weapon runes, Solitary Trial/Solo Challenge).
_meta.renamedBecause: Object keys are rendered into the LLM prompt verbatim, so a key is a retrieval label. Leaving the preview-era key would keep teaching the old name as a topic heading.

_renames.reason: Official notes name the feature Starlight Gala; Guild Starlight Celebration was the preview name.
Keeps 'starlight_cup' in the key as a retrieval anchor for members who read the preview name, while the key itself now states the resolution.
The old key asserted a mode name the official notes do not use, and carried a directive the notes falsify.
The key carried the superseded preview date, and keys are rendered into the prompt.

umbral_tempest.season_4_status: Umbral Tempest Season 4 begins 31 August 2026. Season 4 detail here comes from the official Archero 2 patch notes of 28 Aug 2026 and describes the season as ANNOUNCED, not as observed in play.
umbral_tempest.season_4_class_abilities: Umbral Tempest Season 4 gives each class a new exclusive Class Ability: Ranger gains 'Sword Will', Alchemist gains 'Thermancy', Druid gains 'Symbiosis', and Diviner gains 'Star Eclipse'. Each class gets more distinct combat mechanics and skill combinations. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_4_class_ability_old_names: 'Sword Intent' is NOT a current ability name — it is the superseded preview name for the Ranger's Season 4 Class Ability, which is officially called 'Sword Will'. Likewise 'Boiling' is the superseded preview name for the Alchemist's 'Thermancy'. Always answer with Sword Will and Thermancy, and say the old name was replaced.
umbral_tempest.season_4_monster_mechanic: Umbral Tempest Season 4 adds the 'Main Weapon Restriction Shield' monster mechanic: while the shield is active the damage dealt by your main weapon is limited, so break it fast using your other skills rather than leaning on your main weapon. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.ebonrot_front: Ebonrot Front is named in the Umbral Tempest Season 4 notes, which improve its stage difficulty, its unlock pacing and its weekly resource progress, and list it as one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. What Ebonrot Front actually is is NOT stated — it has stages, and nothing else about it is documented.
umbral_tempest.doomsday_clash: Doomsday Clash is a boss encounter in Umbral Tempest Season 4. Season 4 improves its boss unlock pacing and adds a Solo Challenge mode, and it is one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_4_launch_missions: Umbral Tempest Season 4 adds Season Launch 7-Day Tasks spanning four objective areas — Class Talent, Ebonrot Front, Solitary Trial and Doomsday Clash — whose objectives you complete to claim the task rewards. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.solitary_trial: Solitary Trial is named in the official Umbral Tempest Season 4 patch notes (28 Aug 2026) only as one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. Nothing else about it is documented.
umbral_tempest.coverage_caveat: Coverage of Umbral Tempest is thin: everything recorded is Season 4 announcement material. The event's core loop, currencies, rewards and past seasons are NOT documented. Do not infer general Umbral Tempest mechanics from these Season 4 notes.
umbral_tempest.season_talent_system: The Season Talent System is Umbral Tempest's per-season talent tree. Season 4 upgrades it with talent branches, special nodes, and 6 class skill nodes, allowing targeted enhancement of Class Abilities. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.season_talent_resets: From Umbral Tempest Season 4, Season Talent reset rules are 7 resets per week with a weekly reset, for more freedom in your build. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
umbral_tempest.class_talent: Class Talent is named in the Season 4 notes only as one of the four objective areas of the Season Launch 7-Day Tasks. It is NOT the same thing as a Class Ability (the new per-class skill) or the Season Talent System (the per-season talent tree). Nothing else about Class Talent is documented.
umbral_tempest.solitary_trial_vs_solo_challenge: Two different solo-named things in Season 4: Solitary Trial is one of the four 7-Day Task objective areas, and Solo Challenge is a mode added to Doomsday Clash. They are not the same, and neither is documented beyond that. Do not describe one using the other.
umbral_tempest.classes: Umbral Tempest has its own CLASSES — Ranger, Alchemist, Druid and Diviner — which are separate from the heroes in the characters category. How you pick or change class is NOT documented; only the Season 4 Class Abilities are.
umbral_tempest.sword_will_not_sword_strike: 'Sword Will' is the Ranger's Umbral Tempest Season 4 Class Ability. It is NOT 'Sword Strike', which is a rune theme, an Etched rune family, a Promised Ruins group and an All-Star Cup season theme. Different things — do not answer one with the other's data.
umbral_tempest.alchemist_class_not_talent_card: The Alchemist in Umbral Tempest Season 4 is a CLASS that gains the 'Thermancy' Class Ability. It is not the 'Alchemist' Talent Card in collectibles, which grants Rune Drop Rate +18%. Same word, two unrelated things.
umbral_tempest.main_weapon_restriction_shield_disambigu: The 'Main Weapon Restriction Shield' is a Season 4 MONSTER mechanic. It is unrelated to the 'Main Weapon' rune theme and its Etched/Ability rune families. Do not answer a question about this shield with rune-theme data.

starlight_gala.overview: Starlight Gala is a weekly guild feature — 'Who's the guild's brightest star this week?' Winners are picked from each member's activity and contribution over the past week, receiving a range of honor awards, and one member is named guild MVP. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
starlight_gala.during_the_event: During the gala you can watch the award ceremony, send emotes to join in, claim rewards, and review records from past galas. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
starlight_gala.name: The official name is Starlight Gala. The in-game Update Preview of 23 Aug 2026 called this same feature the 'Guild Starlight Celebration' — a superseded preview name for one feature, not a second event. Always call it the Starlight Gala.
starlight_gala.how_winners_are_chosen: Winners are picked from each member's activity and contribution over the PAST week: a range of honor awards is given out, and one member is named guild MVP. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

guild_hall.ui_upgraded_august_2026: The Guild Hall was fully upgraded in this update: an all-new UI bringing guild info, member management and access to all guild modes together in one place. Every OTHER guild_hall detail here describes the pre-upgrade screen — say so when describing the Guild Hall. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

guild_store.promised_ruin_shovel: The Promised Ruin Shovel was added to the Guild Shop in this update. The notes do not say which sub-tab carries it, what it costs, or what it is used for. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

guild.overview: Guilds are persistent social groups with shared progression and competitive content. The Guild hub is a map view of buildings, each its own sub-feature. The building list here predates the Starlight Gala, which the August 2026 notes add as a new guild feature without saying whether it is a building.
guild.hub_buildings: Guild Hall (members, roles, research, leaderboard), Monster Invasion (guild boss raids), Guild Expedition (multi-guild PvP tournament), Shop / Guild Store (hero shards and random Epic runes), Guild Merchant (community bargain mechanic), and Guild Aid. The Starlight Gala was added later and is not in this list.

campaign.stage_ranges_august_2026: The August 2026 hotfix adds Campaign (Normal) stages 191-200 and Hard stages 176-185. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
campaign.difficulty_reductions: Two SEPARATE difficulty reductions, both true and neither replacing the other: update 1.1.7 lowered the difficulty of campaign stages after Chapter 80, and the August 2026 hotfix lowered it for campaign stages after Chapter 130.
campaign.track_name_mapping: The official patch notes call the two tracks 'Campaign Stages' and 'Hard Stages'. These are the same two tracks recorded elsewhere as Main Chapters and Heroic Chapters: Campaign = Main = Normal Mode, and Hard = Heroic.

in_run.blocking_shield_order: When multiple blocking shields are active at once, the one with the shortest remaining duration is consumed first. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
in_run.battle_speed_tiers: Battle speed tiers are standardised: the modes that offer a speed-up run at exactly 1.5x, 2x and 3x. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

arena.all_star_cup_vs_starlight_gala: All-Star Cup is a PvP tournament; the Starlight Gala is a guild event. They are different things that both contain 'Star' — do not merge them, and do not describe one using the other's rules.
arena.all_star_cup_battle_changes: In All-Star Cup and Mega All-Star Cup, Boss death animations no longer play and the stage timer pauses while you are selecting a Boss. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
arena.all_star_cup_qualifier_scaling: All-Star Cup qualifier monster strength is now scaled by server group. All-Star Cup already groups servers into zones by launch schedule and estimated participant count. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
arena.mega_all_star_cup: Mega All-Star Cup is named in the official patch notes (28 Aug 2026) alongside All-Star Cup and receives the same battle change. Nothing else is documented — what it is, how you enter it, what it rewards, and whether it is a separate mode or a higher tier of All-Star Cup are all unrecorded. Say so plainly and point at !suggest.
arena.arena_shop_promised_ruin_shovel: The Promised Ruin Shovel was added to the Arena Shop in this update; its price and daily limit were not given. The arena_shop item list here predates that addition. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.
arena.starlight_cup_is_all_star_cup: Starlight Cup IS the All-Star Cup: a PvP tournament, NOT the Starlight Gala guild event — they only share the word 'Starlight'. 'Starlight Cup' and 'Super Starlight Cup' were preview names for All-Star Cup and Mega All-Star Cup. Answer any Starlight Cup question from the All-Star Cup entries, never from the Gala's.
arena.starlight_cup_mapping_basis: That mapping is an inference, not a stated one: both sources describe the identical pair of changes in the same update, and the official notes never mention a Starlight Cup. The same preview also said 'Sword Intent' for Sword Will and 'Guild Starlight Celebration' for Starlight Gala.
arena.overview: Arena is the PvP category. Sub-modes: Main Arena, Peak Arena, Rumble Ladder, All-Star Cup, and Mega All-Star Cup.

quick_hunt.energy_option: Configurable per click: 5 energy = 1 run, 10 energy = 2 runs, 25 energy = 5 runs. The August 2026 hotfix added a x10 option; its energy cost was not given in the notes.

advice.energy_efficiency: Of the captured tiers, energy-paid Quick Hunts cost the same 5 energy per run at 5/1, 10/2 and 25/5, so none is more efficient than another. The August 2026 hotfix added a x10 option whose energy cost was not given.

gear_chest.draw_options: All Gear Chests have a 100x Draw option, added in the August 2026 hotfix. Official patch notes, 28 Aug 2026.

custom_facts.text: Official Archero 2 patch notes for the August 2026 hotfix were published on 2026-08-28. They give no version number. They supersede the in-game Update Preview of 2026-08-23, which used different English names for several of the same features.
The August 2026 hotfix adds Campaign stages 191-200 and Hard stages 176-185, and reduces the difficulty of Campaign stages after Chapter 130.

The August 2026 hotfix standardised battle speed tiers so the modes that offer a speed-up run at exactly 1.5x, 2x and 3x, and changed in-run shield handling so that when multiple blocking shields are active at once the one with the shortest remaining duration is consumed first.
The August 2026 hotfix added the Promised Ruin Shovel to both the Guild Shop and the Arena Shop.

custom_facts_repairs.text: An in-game Update Preview dated 2026-08-23 announced a hotfix update for that week, bringing a brand-new chapter, the Starlight Gala, and Umbral Tempest Season 4. The official patch notes name that guild feature the Starlight Gala; 'Guild Starlight Celebration' was the preview name for the same feature.

custom_facts_repairs.reason: Official patch notes attribute this exact change to All-Star Cup and Mega All-Star Cup.

custom_facts_repairs.text: The August 2026 hotfix adds a 100x Draw option to all Gear Chests, a x10 option to Quick Hunt, and an Unequip All option on BOTH Gear and Rune presets that clears the current preset in one tap.

custom_facts_repairs.text: The August 2026 hotfix adds Main Chapters 191-200 and Heroic Chapters 176-185. The official patch notes call these same two tracks 'Campaign Stages' and 'Hard Stages'.

pack_and_chest_items.relic_shovel: Relic Shovel is a digging item. runes.promised_ruins records it as the Promised Ruins dig cost ('300 Gems, or 1 Relic Shovel'); Rune Ruins uses a Ruin Shovel instead. See shovel_disambiguation.
pack_and_chest_items.shovel_disambiguation: Three shovel names appear in the data: Ruin Shovel (Rune Ruins dig cost), Relic Shovel (Promised Ruins dig cost), and Promised Ruin Shovel, added to the Guild Shop and Arena Shop in the August 2026 hotfix. Whether the Promised Ruin Shovel is the same item as the Relic Shovel is NOT documented — do not treat them as the same, and say so if asked.
